user_story:
As a user, I want to add and remove elements on the 'Add/Remove Elements' page so that I can dynamically manage the number of elements displayed. Acceptance Criteria: 
1. When I click the 'Add Element' button, a new element should be added to the page. 
2. The URL should remain the same: 'https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/add_remove_elements/'. 
3. The 'Add Element' button should be visible on the page. 
4. After adding an element, I can remove it by clicking on the newly added element. 
5. The number of elements displayed should decrease by one after removing an element. 
6. The 'flash-messages' div should be present on the page.
